'''December 2000 Waco tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Waco, TX on 20 December 2000. [[Justin Warren]] won it. It is known from Justin Warren's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1565">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-waco-tx-12-20-00d1565/ waco-tx-12-20-00], DeckTech (Justin "hoostino" Warren, 21 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-waco-tx-12-20-00d1565/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Waco, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Justin Warren]]
